name: The Boy
description: A quick-witted traveler who cracks nuts on the road and confidently tricks the Devil into a trap.
visualPrompt: A young boy with bright, clever eyes, wearing simple rustic clothes and sturdy boots, holding a handful of nuts and a small wooden peg, appearing calm and mischievous in a folktale style.

name: The Devil

visualPrompt: A shadowy, impish devilish figure with subtle horns and a sly expression, depicted as able to shrink into a tiny wisp-like form, with a faint red-black aura suggesting menace without gore.

name: The Blacksmith

visualPrompt: A broad-shouldered blacksmith with rolled-up sleeves and a leather apron, soot-smudged face, gripping a heavy sledge hammer beside an anvil and forge fire, rendered in classic folktale illustration style.
